verdict.rationale: The Management API can order terminals for delivery to a chosen location by API instead of the Customer Area, under an 'automating terminal management' section [adyen-pos-docs-11]. Adyen also ships OpenAPI definitions and an official MCP server that an agent could drive [adyen-pos-gh-1][adyen-pos-docs-20][adyen-pos-probe-4]. That is only adjacent to the story: the pack never shows creating a location or store via API, or registering and assigning readers to it, so end-to-end provisioning is unevidenced. Missing for 10: an API to create a store or location, an API to register or assign terminals to that location, documentation of an end-to-end provisioning flow, and hands-on corroboration that an agent or MCP server can perform it.
